run_pipeline_latte: run the LattePipeline to generate a video from a text prompt using classifier-free guidance
encode_prompt_latte: encode a text prompt into T5 hidden state embeddings with optional caption cleaning and masking
decode_latents_latte: decode video latents through the VAE decoder with chunked frame decoding to avoid OOM
prepare_latents_latte: prepare initial noise latents with scheduler scaling for video generation
retrieve_timesteps: retrieve scheduler timesteps from custom timesteps, sigmas, or num_inference_steps
